Draw parameters of a Bayesian logistic regression model

mice_logreg_draw.Rd

Fits a logistic regression on data augmented with pseudo-observations (White, Daniel & Royston, 2010) to prevent perfect prediction, and draws coefficients from the asymptotic normal distribution of the estimates.

Usage

mice_logreg_draw(y, X)

Arguments

y

integer outcome vector (0/1)

X

design matrix (first column is the intercept)

Value

numeric vector of drawn coefficients (aliased coefficients are 0)
